metadata.title: Tarabari Nima · Interactive freight journey
metadata.description: A Persian logistics marketing demo with an interactive route globe and a scroll-driven cargo journey from warehouse to road, port, sea and air.

hero.title: Follow one container all the way.
hero.intro: A Persian-first logistics demo that turns a freight journey into a visual story, from the first lift in the warehouse to the road, port, sea and runway.

product.title: A route you can understand by moving through it.
product.description: The site presents a logistics company through an interactive story, with supporting service, industry and insight pages. Its inquiry form is a demo flow.

features.title: Scroll-driven freight
features.text: A marked container moves between a reach stacker, truck, port crane, ship and aircraft.

features.title: Interactive route globe
features.text: A dotted globe, city labels and route arcs introduce the network before the journey begins.

features.title: Persian-first content
features.text: Responsive RTL pages explain services, industries and logistics insights.

features.title: Guided inquiry demo
features.text: A validated local form demonstrates the request flow without sending data to a server.

engineering.title: Motion with a readable handoff.
engineering.description: Next.js and GSAP coordinate the scroll timeline, while Three.js brings the globe to life. The cargo remains traceable across each stage.

notes.title: Continuous cargo handoffs
notes.text: The container settles on the trailer before departure, then moves under a visible crane and onto the vessel.

notes.title: Responsive motion
notes.text: Desktop and mobile use separate framing and timing, with a readable reduced-motion view.

notes.title: Prepared map geometry
notes.text: Precomputed land points keep the interactive globe responsive during the opening scene.
